courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 沉管基床整平
related.transfer: 可遷移「預製體積與結構質量」與「預製溫度與節段變形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；沉管基床整平的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fabrication volume and structural mass" and "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面；沉管基床整平則以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces; Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling centres on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「預製體積與結構質量」與「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到沉管基床整平，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「高點接觸與局部壓力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” and “Trench section and dredging volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "High-point contact and local pressure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面；沉管水下對接與止水則以沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces; Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing centres on immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「預製體積與結構質量」與「端面姿態與初始接觸」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到沉管水下對接與止水，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” and “End-face attitude and initial contact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
history.text: 本課討論的整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。費馬恩業主公開工廠、溝槽與管節施工脈絡，深中通道則列於密封製造商案例；兩者僅作工法與界面比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Femern describes factory, trench and element interfaces, while the seal manufacturer lists the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. They are method and interface comparisons only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
